cases.title: Products - Rate Cards - Set product organizer fee
cases.description: This test verifies the ability to define and apply organizer-specific rate cards directly to a product within the Showpass Dashboard. This allows organizers to set unique fees for specific products, which are then applied during checkout based on platform groups ('Online', 'In Person') and payment types ('Cash', 'Card', 'Other').
cases.preconditions:
User has permissions to manage products and is logged into the Showpass Dashboard.
An existing product is available for configuration, or a new product is being created.
The organizer has defined the custom fee structure (name, type, amount/percentage, and applicability rules) for the product.
cases.postconditions:
Organizer-specific rate cards (VenueCustomFeeValue linked to a VenueCustomFee) are successfully configured and saved for the target product.
When this product is purchased, the configured organizer fees are correctly calculated and applied based on the purchase context (platform and payment type).
The order confirmation and transaction details accurately reflect the applied product-specific organizer rate card.

steps.action: Navigate to the 'Products' section in the Showpass Dashboard and select an existing product to edit, or create a new product.
steps.expected_result: Product management interface in the Dashboard is accessible.

steps.action: Locate the section for configuring 'Custom Fees' or 'Organizer Rate Cards' for the product.
steps.expected_result: Custom fee/organizer rate card configuration section for the product is found.

steps.action: Define a new custom fee: specify its name (e.g., 'Product Handling Fee'), type (fee or tax), and whether it's a fixed amount (fee_added) or a percentage (fee_percent).
steps.expected_result: New `VenueCustomFee` details for the product are entered and saved.

steps.action: Configure the `VenueCustomFeeValue` for this fee, detailing the fee amount/percentage, applicable item_type (should be 'product' or specific product variant), payment_types (e.g., card, cash), and purchase_platforms (online, in-person).
steps.expected_result: `VenueCustomFeeValue` linked to this `VenueCustomFee` is configured with specific fee parameters and applicability rules.

steps.action: Save the product's configuration.
steps.expected_result: Product configuration, including its organizer rate cards, is saved without errors.

steps.action: As a user (e.g., via a public store page or POS), add the configured product to the cart.
steps.expected_result: Product can be added to the cart.

steps.action: Proceed to checkout, matching a configured platform and payment type for the custom fee.
steps.expected_result: Checkout page is reached for the order containing the product.

steps.action: Observe the checkout summary to ensure the product-specific custom fee is applied correctly.
steps.expected_result: The product-specific custom fee is listed in the order summary with the correctly calculated amount based on its definition and the purchase context.

cases.title: Dashboard - Finance - Payouts - Update payment information and authorization
cases.description: Verifies that an organizer can update payout payment information and authorization from Finance > Payouts > Payment info for supported currencies.
cases.preconditions:
- Organizer or employee is logged into the dashboard with permission to manage payout payment information.
- Test venue uses the selected supported currency.
- Valid banking details, authorization signer, and any required verification code are available.
- Existing payout payment information can be safely updated or restored.
cases.postconditions:
- Original payout payment information is restored if required by the test environment.
- Updated payment preference record is visible in admin/backend data.

steps.action: Open Dashboard > Finance > Payouts > Payment info, or navigate to /manage/finance/payouts/payment-info.
steps.expected_result: The Payment information page loads with banking fields, terms, authorization controls, and save action.

steps.action: Review the displayed payment details and authorization section for the selected currency.
steps.expected_result: Currency-specific terms and required banking fields are shown for the selected supported currency.

steps.action: Enter valid banking details and required authorization information.
steps.expected_result: The form accepts valid values and marks the form dirty/valid only when required fields are complete.

steps.action: Attempt to save before all required authorization fields or verification are complete.
steps.expected_result: The save action is blocked or prompts for required authorization/verification without persisting incomplete data.

steps.action: Complete the required authorization and verification, then save.
steps.expected_result: The update succeeds and the dashboard shows a success notification.

steps.action: Verify the saved payout payment preference in the dashboard and admin/backend data.
steps.expected_result: Saved account details, signature/authorization state, agreement user, and venue association match the submitted data.

cases.title: Dashboard - Finance - Payouts - Verify payment information access restrictions
cases.description: Verifies that payout payment information editing is available only to permitted non-admin organization users, while administrators are blocked with the current restriction message.
cases.preconditions:
- A venue exists with payout payment information available to view or edit.
- Test users are available for a permitted organization user and an administrator/superuser.
- The environment behavior for administrator edit restrictions is known.
cases.postconditions:
- No payout payment information is changed by restricted users.
- Any permitted-user edits are restored if needed.

steps.action: Log in as the permitted organization user and open Finance > Payouts > Payment info.
steps.expected_result: The permitted organization user can access the page.

steps.action: Verify the page shows editable payment details and authorization controls.
steps.expected_result: Editable fields and the save action are available when the user has the required permission.

steps.action: Log out and log in as an administrator/superuser.
steps.expected_result: The administrator/superuser can navigate to the page for review.

steps.action: Open the same venue payment information page.
steps.expected_result: The page displays the restriction message that administrators are not permitted to update payment information.

steps.action: Attempt to edit or save payout payment information as the administrator/superuser.
steps.expected_result: The administrator/superuser cannot save changes and the payout payment preference remains unchanged.

cases.title: Dashboard - Finance - Payouts - Verify payment information update notification
cases.description: Verifies that updating payout payment information triggers the expected payment preference update notification with masked banking details.
cases.preconditions:
- Organizer or employee can update payout payment information for the venue.
- Notification recipients are configured for the venue and finance/accounting workflow.
- Email or task output can be inspected in the test environment.
cases.postconditions:
- Original payout payment information is restored if required.
- Notification artifacts are retained for review or cleaned up according to test-data policy.

steps.action: Open Finance > Payouts > Payment info and update payout payment information with valid authorization.
steps.expected_result: The payment information form accepts the update.

steps.action: Save the update.
steps.expected_result: A success notification appears and the payout payment preference is saved.

steps.action: Inspect the email/task output sent for the payment preference update.
steps.expected_result: A payment preference update notification is generated.

steps.action: Verify the recipient list.
steps.expected_result: Finance/accounting and configured venue recipients are included without duplicate email addresses.

steps.action: Verify the email content and banking details.
steps.expected_result: Sensitive banking details are masked where expected, and the message includes the signer, signed date, venue, and updated payment information context.

cases.title: Core - Internal Rate Cards - Verify internal Stripe processing rate card is passed onto customer during checkout

steps.action: Select a supported platform and item type from the case parameters.
steps.expected_result: The selected item is available for purchase.

steps.action: Open the selected item on the selected purchase surface.
steps.expected_result: The item opens successfully on the selected surface.

steps.action: Verify fee visibility before adding the item to the basket.
steps.expected_result: All-in pricing or fee display matches the configured customer-paid processing fee behavior.

cases.title: Core - Internal Rate Cards - Verify Internal Showpass Rate Card Passed Onto Customer Using Checkout Flow
cases.description:
This core test ensures that internal Showpass processing rate cards are correctly applied to each item in the basket/checkout and are accurately displayed on item detail pages across various platforms and item types. This is crucial, as it represents the core of our business.

1. With super admin privileges, set the Showpass fees for your event/venue and configure the fees to be passed on to customers.
2. Locate the item using the public/venue-facing side. Verify that the displayed price(s) are correct.
3. Add the item(s) to your basket. Ensure that the cart total is accurate.
4. Complete the checkout flow. Confirm that the final price is correct on the confirmation email, transaction page, and Stripe dashboard.
cases.preconditions:
As a super admin, configure the desired internal Showpass fee(s) or tax(es) using internal rate cards under `/dashboard/financials/internal-fees/`.

Fees or taxes can also be set on the event edit page: `/dashboard/events/{slug}/manage/#/edit/`.
cases.postconditions:
Internal Showpass processing fees are accurately calculated and applied to each item in the basket and to the overall order.

The visibility of Showpass fees (customer-facing or absorbed) aligns with the configured settings.

Transaction details on payment gateway dashboards (e.g., Stripe, Square) and Showpass receipts correctly reflect applied Showpass fees.

steps.action: Select a platform and view an item type.
steps.expected_result: The item type is displayed correctly.

steps.action: Verify the all-in price on the item detail page, checking how Showpass fees are displayed.
steps.expected_result: The all-in price is accurate. Showpass fees are shown if not absorbed; hidden if absorbed.

steps.action: Add an item to the basket.
steps.expected_result: Correct Showpass fees are applied to the single item in the basket.

steps.action: Add more items to the basket.
steps.expected_result: Correct Showpass fees are applied per item for all items in the basket.

steps.action: Initiate checkout and proceed to the order review page.
steps.expected_result: Showpass fees are correctly displayed on the order review page.

steps.action: Complete the checkout.
steps.expected_result: The final order confirmation shows correct application of Showpass fees to the entire basket.

steps.action: If applicable, verify the transaction details on the payment gateway dashboard (Stripe/Square) and compare with the Showpass receipt.
steps.expected_result: Fee details on the payment gateway dashboard and Showpass receipt match the applied Showpass fees.

cases.title: Core - Rate Cards - Verify that items reset to correct price tier for internal and organizer rate cards
cases.description:
This Core test verifies that event item prices correctly update to reflect changes in price tiers or fee structures (based on internal rate cards or organizer settings) when price-tiering is enabled and relevant updates (e.g., admin actions like "update fee") are performed.

Related original test case titles (merged into this Core test):

* Verify that fees successfully update for TT with locked price after changing price (price tier enabled)
cases.preconditions:
As a super admin, set desired internal rate card(s)/tax(es) at `/dashboard/financials/internal-fees/`.
As an event organizer with "manage venue" permissions, set desired fee(s)/tax(es) at `/dashboard/venues/edit/`.
Fees/taxes can also be set on event/product edit pages: `/dashboard/events/{slug}/manage/#/edit/`.
Price-tiering for the event item must be enabled.
An event item is available for purchase with defined price tiers.
cases.postconditions:
The price of an event item updates correctly on detail pages and during checkout when its price tier changes.
After venue/custom fees or internal rate cards are changed and an "update fee" admin action is run, the item prices reflect these updated fees correctly.

steps.action: Select a platform and view an event item with price tiers enabled.
steps.expected_result: The event item is displayed with its current price based on the active price tier.

steps.action: Purchase the item with the payment type of your choice. Note the price.
steps.expected_result: The item is purchased at the current tier's price.

steps.action: If possible and applicable for the test scenario, manually change the active price tier for the event item or simulate conditions that would trigger a tier change.
steps.expected_result: The price tier for the item is changed.

steps.action: View the event item again on the detail page.
steps.expected_result: The item's price on the detail page updates to reflect the new active price tier or pricing rules.

steps.action: Modify venue or custom fee settings, or internal rate card settings.
steps.expected_result: Rate card settings are updated.

steps.action: Run the "update fee" admin action for the event or venue.
steps.expected_result: The admin action completes successfully.

steps.action: View the event item again on the detail page and attempt to purchase it.
steps.expected_result: The item's price on the detail page and at checkout accurately reflects the updated fee structure (based on new rate cards/settings) and current price tier. A new purchase uses this updated price.

cases.title: Core - Organizer Rate Cards - Verify custom taxes on organizer fees during checkout

cases.title: Web Dashboard - Organization Settings - Configure shipping fulfillment controls
cases.description: Verify that an organizer can configure organization-level shipping fulfillment controls that affect delivery-capable checkout flows.
cases.preconditions: The organizer user has permission to manage organization settings. A venue exists with at least one shipping-capable event ticket or product fixture available for downstream verification.
cases.postconditions: Shipping fulfillment settings are restored to their original values. Any test shipping copy, thresholds, allowed countries, and blocked regions are removed unless the fixture is intentionally reusable.
